title: Schooldays with Bechet's nephew and sneaking his father's clarinet
summary: Harris recalls going to school with a Bechet nephew and teaching himself on his father's clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Sidney Bechet's nephew and I used to go to school together. We used to take up music together. He had a nephew who played banjo and guitar.
Which one is that? Was that one of Dr. Bechet's sons?
I don't know if it was the doctor but he was from back in Great Town. No.

Banjo and guitar. Yeah. I didn't know about him. He got one of his brothers a male carrying off. Yeah. Well that was, today she's nephew. Well I mostly, when I was back there I was small going to school and that's mostly, you know, I got in the music line by being around with fellas like that, you know what I mean, when that's gotten arrested in it. Then my father he was a missin' when he'd go to work like that I'd steal a clarinet and go in the back and try to play something. You ever play clarinet? I tried it man but I never could make nothing out of it. But it didn't take me long to play it after I learned my instrument or the alto, you know, I mean it didn't take me long.
You hear the way to get over that alto you'd wonder why you'd never play some clarinet anyhow.
